hypothesis: A graph-native open canvas can preserve all bounded Workspace ontology nodes and labeled relations while disclosing complete node detail in an accessible focus lens without semantic mutation.
success_metrics: every relation endpoint is rendered or represented as an explicit external reference
one click or keyboard activation opens complete available node detail
closing detail restores access to the full canvas
no create, edit, delete, connect, accept, register, publish, or ontology mutation control is exposed
desktop and narrow viewport browser checks pass without non-local requests or runtime errors
exclusions: publication, release, deployment, or external effects
claim_ceiling: Local candidate UX experiment against two digest-bound Workspace projection files only; no capability adoption, ontology authority, implementation conformance, product proof, publication, release, or deployment.
